Hannah —

Thanks. The windows you proposed look good but quick heads-up: our Head of ML Ops (Maya) will be traveling the week of 9/8–9/12 and can only join remotely for a more technical session. Also, after chatting with the CTO they prefer a technical deep-dive rather than a high-level product demo — specifically: model hosting patterns, VPC/private deployment, and quantization/latency tradeoffs.

Would you be open to converting the intro into a two-step engagement:
1) a 90-minute remote technical deep-dive with your SE and our ML team (we're in PDT)
2) a one-day onsite pilot/workshop the following month (rough dates: week of 10/13) to run a hands-on POC with our infra team

If that works, can we scope out what Redwood would need from our side for the onsite pilot and any rough pricing/commit commitments we should expect?

- Alex

alex@federalai.com | +1 (202) 555-0139
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morales <alex@federalai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo — quick sync (proposed dates)

Alex —

Absolutely — converting to a two-step technical plan makes sense and matches what we typically do for accounts running sensitive workloads. Proposed outline: 

Part A — 90-min remote technical deep-dive (SE-led)
- Objectives: architecture alignment, VPC/Private deployment options, perf baseline (latency/throughput), quantization recommendations
- Prework: sample request profile, target RPS, model family(s) you expect to use
- Deliverable: technical recommendations doc + runbook

Part B — 1-day onsite pilot/workshop (on your infra or ours)
- Objectives: validate perf & integration, hands-on KV/prefix cache tests, end-to-end sample POC
- Redwood brings: 2 engineers (SE + infra), prebuilt test harness, deployment checklist
- Logistics we need: a room/network access for GPUs or access to your cloud project, a point person for networking/infra, and a local calendar for arrival times

I attached a lightweight agenda and a mutual action plan template to this thread to make scoping easier. Rough estimate for the onsite pilot (staffing + workshop materials + travel): $15–25k depending on whether you host infra or we provide a dedicated environment. We can firm up pricing once we confirm scope.

Availability for Part A (90-min remote):
- Thu 9/11 09:30–11:00 PDT
- Fri 9/12 13:00–14:30 PDT

Let me know which works — I can block a calendar and include a short pre-call to collect prework artifacts.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alex

Alex/Maya —

Looping in from the sales ops side. Quick answers:
- We can run the Part A deep-dive under our standard trial terms; no signed MSA required to run a remote technical session.
- For the onsite pilot, we typically ask for a short pilot SOW (1 page) that covers scope, dates, and a statement of work — attached is a template 'mutual-action-plan.xlsx' you can fill in.
- Billing note: if FederalAI wants Redwood to bring GPUs/environments we charge a pilot fee (estimate from Soojin). If you provide cloud infra and project access, pilot fees are usually limited to engineering time + travel.

I'll have our contracts team prepare a concise SOW once you confirm dates and hosting model — procurement@redwood.ai will coordinate.

Thanks — booking Part A now.
